appliesToWhy: Only ids where a read source shows a foot bar or foot lever: the seated chest press (university guide and two manufacturer pages) and the seated pullover (manufacturer page). incline_machine_press and shoulder_press are left out: no read source shows a foot assist on them.

steps.text: Press the foot bar with your legs to bring the handles out.
Sore shoulders? Always start with the foot bar.
After the set, put your feet back on the foot bar.
Then drop your arms and lower the handles slowly.
Push the foot lever to bring the handles to you.
This stops you over-reaching for the start.

claims.text: On a chest press with a foot pedal or foot bar, press it out with the legs to bring the handles to the start position.

quotes.text: Once you have your weight selected, use your legs to press out the foot advance pedal. This will bring the handles to the start position.
quotes.where: How to Setup & Use the Chest Press Machine

quotes.text: Wide foot bar raises handles to starting position.

claims.text: After each set, put the feet back on the pedal, drop the arms to the sides and slowly lower the handles to their resting position; the maker says the foot assist eases both starting and ending.

quotes.text: After each set, place your feet back on the advance pedal. Then, drop your arms to your side and slowly lower the handles back to their resting position.
quotes.where: How to Setup & Use the Chest Press Machine

quotes.text: The foot-assist pre-stretch lever arm allows for easy starting and ending exercise positions.

claims.text: People with shoulder limitations should always use the foot pedal to set the handles to the start position.

quotes.text: Those with shoulder limitations should always use the foot advance pedal when setting the handles to the start position.
quotes.where: A Word of Caution and Common Mistakes

claims.text: On the seated pullover, the foot lever brings the handles to a comfortable start position, so you do not over-extend reaching for them.

quotes.text: Foot lever brings the handles to a comfortable starting position.
The foot pedal brings the weight to you so you’re not over-extending and risking injury.

notes: Same rule sourced in cards/machine_pullover.json c2, c3, c5 (Marquette); not re-read here, see gaps.
